recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless the Vocabulary work group later reopens required-binding profile narrowing semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-17479 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 vocabulary change request asking the Required Binding Strength text to make explicit that derived profiles may exclude codes from a required value set, rather than only stating ambiguous business rules, while still not allowing profiles to add codes.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to commit 66ae1e40f1bc02283363c872db14035fc795f8f7. That terminology reconciliation commit included GF#17479 and changed source/terminologies.html so the derived-profile sentence explicitly said profiles may remove codes from allowed use but cannot specify new or additional codes.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini maps resourceType to the terminologies page, supporting source/terminologies.html as the active terminology narrative. Later Published issue FHIR-17480 replaced the Required Binding Strength section for R5 with no expected behavior change and preserved the same rule, now saying profiles cannot specify additional codes. The #implementers Zulip thread that led to the issue confirms that narrowing by excluding codes is allowed and extending required bindings is not.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because current source/terminologies.html already says derived profiles may state rules on which codes can be used, including removing codes from allowed use, but cannot specify additional codes for these elements.
